concept.title: Scenario: AI-powered documentation
concept.shortdesc: A customer support chatbot needs to answer questions about product features. With DITA-structured content:

conbody.p:
A customer support chatbot needs to answer questions about product features. With DITA-structured content:
The AI system indexes all concept topics by their <shortdesc> and <keywords>
User questions are matched against this semantic index
The AI retrieves the relevant topic and generates an accurate response
Source attribution is automatic because each topic has a unique identifier

section.title: Result
section.p: Without DITA's structured approach, the AI would need to parse unstructured documents, leading to lower accuracy and frequent hallucinations.
